name: Straight cut
mechanism: Immediate image replacement without blending
creative_use: Default for all storytelling; pace and emotional punctuation

name: Cut on action
mechanism: Join an action across two angles at its most readable motion point
failure_check: Direction and limb state must agree

name: Eyeline match
mechanism: Cut from gaze to spatially coherent object or person
creative_use: Point of view and audience attention

name: Shot/reverse-shot
mechanism: Alternate viewpoints across established conversation axis

name: Reaction cut
mechanism: Leave action to reveal another person's specific response

name: Cut-in
mechanism: Move to a close detail contained in the parent action

name: Cutaway
mechanism: Temporary detail or parallel view conceals omitted time

name: Invisible dark cut
mechanism: Cut across full-frame darkness or silhouette

name: Foreground occlusion cut
mechanism: Use a passing body or object to conceal the edit

name: Motion-blur hidden cut
mechanism: Place edit during high blur at similar flow direction

name: Composition hold / delayed cut
mechanism: Hold a frame until the dramatic information changes
failure_check: Holding without new information feels slack

name: Cut after movement
mechanism: Wait for action completion rather than cut on impact

name: Insert-and-return
mechanism: Cut to an insert then return on changed context
creative_use: Story detail without a full scene change

name: Reverse angle inversion
mechanism: Deliberately swap axis after a clear spatial reset

name: Graphic match
mechanism: Align shapes or dominant composition between shots
failure_check: Looks ornamental when meanings do not connect

name: Subject match
mechanism: Align subject types, poses, profiles or silhouettes

name: Action match
mechanism: Continue a specific movement through the cut
creative_use: Carry momentum across time and space

name: Direction match
mechanism: Preserve consistent movement vectors across shots

name: Speed match
mechanism: Cut between objects sharing apparent screen velocity

name: Scale match
mechanism: Keep a focal object the same screen size across shots
creative_use: Conceal change of location or object

name: Color match
mechanism: Connect similar chromatic focal regions
failure_check: Color as sole reason often feels thin

name: Luminance match
mechanism: Connect highlight/shadow distribution

name: Texture match
mechanism: Align grain, weave, foam, fabric or surface patterns
failure_check: VFX smoothness conflicts with physical texture

name: Eye-position match
mechanism: Maintain eye coordinates or eye-line direction

name: Object-function match
mechanism: Different objects perform the same physical task

name: Cause-and-effect match
mechanism: Cut from action to its distant consequence
failure_check: Implies causal link not in script

name: Conceptual / intellectual match
mechanism: Juxtapose unlike images that share an idea

name: Sound match
mechanism: Join matching sound signatures over different sources

name: Gesture / behavior rhyme
mechanism: Match an actor's posture, hesitation or habitual gesture

name: Negative-space match
mechanism: Connect vacant areas of composition across two shots
failure_check: Subject enters wrong side of frame

mechanism: Remove intermediate action within near-matched framing

family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits

mechanism: Omit an expected narrative interval
creative_use: Trust viewer inference and increase pace

family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
name: Time-jump match
mechanism: Match composition across different days or years
creative_use: Make a passage of time immediate

family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits

mechanism: Briefly show a later known or hypothetical event

family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits

mechanism: Transition to a prior event with an earned perceptual link

family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits

mechanism: Alternate actions in separate locations

family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits

mechanism: Interleave separate events with thematic relation

mechanism: Link images by evolving idea rather than continuity

mechanism: Organize cut lengths by a measurable progression

family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits

mechanism: Edit to movement patterns inside shots

mechanism: Edit on emotional qualities across images

mechanism: Make a new argument by image collision

mechanism: Interlace stages of one event nonlinearly

name: J-cut / audio pre-lap
mechanism: Bring next shot or scene sound in before the image

name: L-cut / audio post-lap
mechanism: Let preceding shot's sound outlive its image

name: Sound bridge
mechanism: Carry a common ambience, effect or music bed over the cut

name: Audio match cut
mechanism: Align related sound events from distinct environments

name: Acoustic morph
mechanism: Gradually transform a sound's spectrum or envelope into another

name: Reverb-tail bridge
mechanism: Carry the decay of a voice or struck object into next image

name: Hard silence cut
mechanism: Remove ambience/music exactly at the image change

name: Ambience swap
mechanism: Change environmental bed ahead of or after picture
creative_use: Signal a new location before reveal

name: Dialogue bridge
mechanism: Complete one conversation's line over a new setting
failure_check: Implies direct dialog at wrong place

name: Musical downbeat cut
mechanism: Cut exactly on a strong musical attack

name: Anticipation cut
mechanism: Change picture before a predicted drum or lyric event

name: Afterbeat cut
mechanism: Delay picture past rhythmic emphasis

name: Sonic perspective shift
mechanism: Transition diegetic sound from internal to external viewpoint
creative_use: Alter relationship to character or space

name: Cross dissolve
mechanism: Blend adjacent shots through opacity

name: Film dissolve (linear light)
mechanism: Blend exposure response in linear-light space

name: Additive dissolve
mechanism: Add bright regions across frames while mixing

name: Non-additive dissolve
mechanism: Blend without additive brightening bias

name: Fade to black

name: Fade to white
mechanism: Gradually increase to white

name: Dip to color
mechanism: Pass through a selected solid color

name: Linear wipe
mechanism: One image reveals another along moving boundary

name: Diagonal wipe
mechanism: Slanted boundary reveal across frames

name: Iris in/out
mechanism: Circle opens or closes visual field

name: Clock / radial wipe
mechanism: Pivot a radial wipe around image center

name: Venetian-blind wipe
mechanism: Repeated strips replace image

name: Page turn / peel
mechanism: Peel image as physical page

family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions

mechanism: Use exact environmental or design color to bridge

name: Alpha matte reveal
mechanism: Use animated shape/transparency to reveal next plate

name: Rotoscope / actor wipe

name: Depth-based wipe
